name: Cửa Lò beach break, 2 days 1 night
summary: Two days on the long sand at Cửa Lò with a sea-view room, the morning fish market and dinner on the beach road. Run by a Cửa Lò operator, not an agency in Hà Nội.
itinerary: Day 1 · 07:00 pick-up in Vinh, check in at the beach road, afternoon swim, seafood dinner at the night stalls.
Day 2 · 05:30 the boats come in at the fish market, breakfast, free morning on the sand, 14:00 return to Vinh.

name: Cửa Lò seafood night walk
summary: An evening along the stalls behind the beach with a local host who orders for you: grilled squid, mantis shrimp, clam soup, and what to pay for each.
itinerary: 18:30 meet on the beach road, four stalls over three hours, back where you started by 21:30.

name: Cửa Lò sea-view room, 2 nights
summary: A family-run guest house one street back from the sand, two nights with breakfast. Rooms sleep three; a cot is free for a child under six.
itinerary: Check in from 14:00, check out by 11:00. Breakfast 06:30–09:00 on the balcony.

name: Kim Liên village, half day
summary: Uncle Hồ's hometown with a guide from Nam Đàn: the two family houses, the lotus pond and the village lanes, finishing at a tea house on the way out.
itinerary: 07:30 leave Vinh, 08:30–11:30 the village with a local guide, 12:30 back in Vinh.

name: Thanh Chương tea hills at dawn
summary: Out before light to walk the tea rows while the mist is still on them, with the family that picks them. Back for breakfast by nine.
itinerary: 04:45 leave Vinh, 06:00 the hills with the picking family, 07:30 breakfast, 09:30 back in Vinh.

name: Tea Island boat and entry ticket
summary: The ticket on its own: entry to the tea islands and the boat out across the water, timed for the hour before sunset.
itinerary: Choose a slot when you book. The boat leaves on the half hour; the crossing and the islands take about two hours.

name: Pù Mát by boat and jeep, 2 days
summary: Up the Giăng river by boat into Pù Mát, a night in a stilt house at Bản Nưa, and out by jeep along the forest track the next afternoon.
itinerary: Day 1 · 06:30 from Vinh, river boat from Phà Lài, afternoon in the forest, night at Bản Nưa.
Day 2 · Breakfast with the household, jeep along the forest track, 17:00 back in Vinh.
includes: One night in a stilt house

name: Khe Kèm waterfall trek
summary: A full day in Pù Mát: the forest road to Khe Kèm, the climb beside the falls, and an hour in the pool at the bottom before the drive back.
itinerary: 06:00 from Vinh, 09:00 trailhead, the falls and the pool, 15:00 leave, 18:00 back in Vinh.

name: Bản Nưa stilt house, 2 nights
summary: Two nights in a Thái stilt house at the edge of the park, cooking with the household in the evening and walking to the river in the morning.
itinerary: Arrive any afternoon. Dinner is cooked together at 18:30; breakfast is at 07:00.

name: Vinh airport to Cửa Lò transfer
summary: A seven-seat car from Vinh airport to any address in Cửa Lò, met at arrivals with your name on a board. Fixed price for the car, not per person.
itinerary: Give your flight when you book. The driver waits up to 60 minutes after landing.
includes: The whole car, up to 7 people

name: Cửa Lò sunrise with the fishing fleet
summary: Out with a Cửa Lò crew before first light, in as the catch is landed, then breakfast at the market with what came off the boat.
itinerary: 04:30 on the sand, out with the fleet, in by 07:30, breakfast at the market until 08:30.
